title: Конспирация перед звонком Елены  (Conspiracy During Elena's Call)

segments.t: When his phone rings again, Chef Barinov frantically hushes the entire kitchen crew so Elena Pavlovna will not hear kitchen clatter in the background. After faking static on the line and hanging up, he barks at the cooks to get back to their stations.
Вас там Дмитрий Владимирович ждет в зале?
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Everyone be quiet.' Over the call and the phone, Barinov answers Ainura without a second thought.
'Be quiet, I said.' Nagiyev explains that be quiet he said, keeping his voice calm and direct.
'Hello, I am listening.' Noting that she is listening keeps Ainura's side of the story simple and clear.
'So just relax and enjoy your rest.' Around the call and point, Barinov sets a calm, everyday tone with Ainura.
'Yeah, sounds good.' Even though yeah sounds good, Nagiyev keeps a steady face in front of Ainura.
'The reception is bad.' Admitting that the reception is bad shows Ainura being honest for a change.
'The connection is really terrible.' Saying that the connection is really terrible is how Barinov sets the tone with Ainura.
'You little mouse.' With the kitchen and plan in play, Nagiyev keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Вас там Дмитрий Владимирович ждет в зале?

'Dmitry Vladimirovich is waiting for you out in the dining room.' Questioning whether Dmitry Vladimirovich is waiting for Barinov out in the dining room is how Ainura tests Barinov's story. Notice how she sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'And why are you all standing around?' Wondering why Ainura all standing around is is how Barinov puts Ainura on the spot.
'Get back to work right now.' Admitting that Ainura should get back to work right now shows Nagiyev being honest for a change.
'Yes, Chef.' Over the work and the call, Ainura answers Barinov without a second thought.
'Hand over the uniform.' Explaining that Ainura should hand over the uniform lays the cards on the table for Ainura. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Вас там Дмитрий Владимирович ждет в зале?

That wraps up this scene as chef Barinov hushes the entire kitchen when Elena Pavlovna calls again, pretending he has bad reception on the plane before ordering the cooks back to work. Until next time!
